lines.zh: 我在月尘上滑行，翼尖扫过环形山。
lines.en: I glide over moon dust, wingtips brushing the crater rim.

lines.zh: 夜风托着我，我绕着月面慢慢巡行。
lines.en: The night wind holds me as I circle the pale surface.

lines.zh: 我低飞过石堆，影子在身后拉长。
lines.en: I skim past stone piles, my shadow stretching behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都不落地，我只在空气里走。
lines.en: I never touch ground; all my steps are in the air.

lines.zh: 月光把我的轮廓映得很淡很淡。
lines.en: Moonlight draws my outline faint and fainter still.

lines.zh: 我边飞边数星星，数到第七颗就乱了。
lines.en: I count stars in flight and lose the tally at seven.

lines.zh: 我在半空转向，风从我的骨缝穿过。
lines.en: I bank in midair; wind slips between my bones.

lines.zh: 浮尘黏在翼膜上，我抖了抖才走。
lines.en: Dust clings to my wing membrane; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我沿着陨坑边缘滑，像一片薄薄的影。
lines.en: I slide along the crater rim like a thin shadow.

lines.zh: 谁在下面走动，我就在上面跟着。
lines.en: Someone walks below; I keep pace above them.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，只够看清每一块石头。
lines.en: I fly slowly, just enough to study every stone.

lines.zh: 月亮挂在头顶，我绕着它转了小半圈。
lines.en: The moon hangs overhead; I make half a circle around it.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翼膜轻轻颤着。
lines.en: I hover in place, my wing membrane quivering softly.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我的骨头咯咯作响。
lines.en: The wind rises and my bones click together.

lines.zh: 幽魂粉末在口袋里沙沙地响。
lines.en: Ghostly powder rustles in the pouch at my hip.

lines.zh: 我盯着月亮，好像它会回答我。
lines.en: I stare at the moon as if it might answer me.

lines.zh: 我把弓弦松了松，又拉紧。
lines.en: I loosen the bowstring, then draw it taut again.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，连回声都不肯来。
lines.en: It is too quiet here; even echoes refuse to come.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的呼吸，虽然我并不呼吸。
lines.en: I count my breaths, though I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 一枚小石子从坑沿滚下去，我听着。
lines.en: A pebble rolls down the crater; I listen to it fall.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在月尘上，薄得像纸。
lines.en: My shadow on the dust is thin as paper.

lines.zh: 没有猎物，我就慢慢磨着箭头。
lines.en: With no prey around, I slowly hone my arrowheads.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子，像在找天上的东西。
lines.en: You look up as though searching the sky for something.

lines.zh: 我在上面看你，看了很久。
lines.en: I watch you from above, and I keep watching.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛反射月光，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your eyes catch the moonlight; I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 别低头，我要看看你的脸。
lines.en: Don't look down; I want a look at your face.

lines.zh: 你身上没有幽魂粉末的味道。
lines.en: You carry no scent of ghostly powder on you.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，正好在我的射程里。
lines.en: You stand right there, well inside my range.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，你没发现。
lines.en: I circle above your head and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 抬头，凡人，月亮在上面看着你。
lines.en: Look up, mortal; the moon is watching you from above.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在月面的冷气里发白。
lines.en: Your breath pales in the moon's thin, cold air.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的东西，那是金属。
lines.en: I recognize what you hold; that is worked metal.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜破了个口子，风灌进来。
lines.en: Wind pours through a tear in my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，我听见了。
lines.en: A bone cracked, and I heard it happen.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，我歪着飞了一段。
lines.en: That one was heavy; I flew crooked for a while.

lines.zh: 疼是活人才有的感觉。
lines.en: Pain is a feeling only the living have.

lines.zh: 我的粉末撒了一地，可惜了。
lines.en: My powder spills across the ground; what a waste.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可我还飞得起来。
lines.en: You landed it, but I can still fly.

lines.zh: 我退到月尘后面喘了一会儿。
lines.en: I retreat behind the dust to catch myself.

lines.zh: 箭头掉了，我懒得捡。
lines.en: An arrow dropped, and I can't be bothered to fetch it.

lines.zh: 我身上裂了一道，月光透进来。
lines.en: A crack opened in me, and moonlight leaks through.

lines.zh: 别高兴太早，我还有箭。
lines.en: Don't celebrate yet, archer; I still have arrows.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，只要你留在射程内。
lines.en: I don't want what you hold; I want you in range.

lines.zh: 那点吃的留给自己吧，月亮不喂我。
lines.en: Keep that food; the moon does not feed me.

lines.zh: 你举着东西晃，我只看见一个靶子。
lines.en: You wave it about; I only see a target.

lines.zh: 幽魂粉末？你有？让我闻闻。
lines.en: Ghostly powder? You have some? Let me catch the scent.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜晃，我又不是兔子。
lines.en: Stop waving carrots at me; I am not a rabbit.

lines.zh: 你手里的光很晃眼，收起来。
lines.en: That glow in your hand is blinding; put it away.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是想要，是想看清。
lines.en: I come closer not to take, but to look.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，箭才对我有用。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; arrows do.

lines.zh: 你要是丢下它，我会替你收着。
lines.en: If you drop it, I will keep it for you.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，只是好奇你举多久。
lines.en: I hover and wait, curious how long you'll hold it up.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的翼尖，我歪了一下。
lines.en: You knock my wingtip; I tilt sideways.

lines.zh: 我飘开了，别再用肩膀顶我。
lines.en: I drift aside; stop shoving me with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 骨头很轻，可撞上来还是疼。
lines.en: My bones are light, but the bump still hurts.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶，你怎么撞得到我。
lines.en: I'm above your head; how did you hit me at all?

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的箭差点掉下来。
lines.en: Step back; my arrow nearly slipped loose.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的弓拉不开。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I cannot draw my bow.

lines.zh: 翼膜被你碰得皱了一角。
lines.en: You creased one corner of my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我撞上石柱，灰尘落了一身。
lines.en: I hit a stone pillar and dust settles over me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没让路。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us gives way.

lines.zh: 你再挤，我就飞到更高的地方。
lines.en: Push again and I'll fly somewhere higher.

lines.zh: 月亮维度里没有谁和我配对。
lines.en: No one in this moon realm pairs with me.

lines.zh: 我这样的东西，不留下后代。
lines.en: A thing like me leaves no offspring behind.

lines.zh: 别指望我孵蛋，我连巢都没有。
lines.en: Don't expect me to hatch eggs; I have no nest.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，我们只交换一次箭。
lines.en: When kin meet, we trade exactly one arrow.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这片没有空气的天。
lines.en: My companion is this airless sky.

lines.zh: 月光下没有婚礼，只有巡夜。
lines.en: Under moonlight there are no weddings, only night patrols.

lines.zh: 我独自飞了太久，忘了怎么靠近。
lines.en: I have flown alone so long I forgot how to come close.

lines.zh: 若你见到另一个我，替我打个招呼。
lines.en: If you meet another of me, say hello for me.

lines.zh: 我们不群居，只在射程内相认。
lines.en: We do not flock; we know each other only by range.

lines.zh: 繁衍是活物的事，我早就不是了。
lines.en: Breeding is for the living; I stopped being that long ago.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块发亮的碎石，收进袋子。
lines.en: I pick up a glinting shard and tuck it in my pouch.

lines.zh: 这枚箭头断了，我还是捡回来。
lines.en: This arrowhead is broken, but I still take it.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把月尘，让它从指缝漏下去。
lines.en: I scoop moon dust and let it leak through my fingers.

lines.zh: 地上落着一根羽毛，不是我的。
lines.en: A single feather lies on the ground, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我把东西捡起来，只是不想它被踩。
lines.en: I pick it up only so it won't be trampled.

lines.zh: 这块石头有幽魂的味道，我要了。
lines.en: This stone smells of ghosts; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时翼膜扫过地面。
lines.en: As I bend, my wing membrane sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西都归捡到的人。
lines.en: Whatever falls belongs to whoever picks it up.

lines.zh: 我捡了又放下，它太沉了。
lines.en: I lift it, then set it down; it is too heavy.

lines.zh: 别抢，这颗石子是我先看见的。
lines.en: Don't grab it; I saw this pebble first.

lines.zh: 有东西动了，我的弓自己抬起来。
lines.en: Something moved; my bow lifts on its own.

lines.zh: 我看到你了，别再往石头后面躲。
lines.en: I see you; stop hiding behind that stone.

lines.zh: 从这么远，我也能把你钉在地上。
lines.en: Even from here I can pin you to the ground.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的月面，就算我的猎物。
lines.en: You stepped onto my moon; now you are prey.

lines.zh: 风向对了，距离也对了。
lines.en: The wind is right, and so is the distance.

lines.zh: 我拉满弦，指尖不再发抖。
lines.en: I draw to full; my fingertips stop trembling.

lines.zh: 那副铠甲挡不住从上面落下的箭。
lines.en: That armor won't stop an arrow falling from above.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，在月光下太显眼。
lines.en: Your body heat stands out under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我选好了落点，就在你脚边。
lines.en: I have chosen where it lands: right by your feet.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动只会让我更好瞄准。
lines.en: Don't run; moving just makes you easier to aim at.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: The torch in your hand gives your position away.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，从你抬头那一刻起。
lines.en: I marked you the moment you looked up.

lines.zh: 这一箭不为饥饿，只为月光。
lines.en: This arrow is not for hunger, but for moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁住你，像锁住一颗星。
lines.en: My gaze locks on you like it locks on a star.

lines.zh: 环形山把影子拉长，我看见了。
lines.en: The crater stretches your shadow; I see it.

lines.zh: 我的箭头跟着你走，一寸不差。
lines.en: My arrowhead follows you without a finger's slip.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就把准星往左挪。
lines.en: You step left; I shift my aim left.

lines.zh: 别以为树能挡住月亮。
lines.en: Don't think a tree can block out the moon.

lines.zh: 我在等你停下来喘气。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to stop and catch your breath.

lines.zh: 弦上的力道，我算得比你准。
lines.en: I judge the draw's tension better than you do.

lines.zh: 你再走三步，就该听见风声了。
lines.en: Three more steps and you'll hear the wind.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，让你的盾找不到方向。
lines.en: I circle so your shield cannot find a side.

lines.zh: 你的影子出卖了你的下一步。
lines.en: Your shadow betrays your next step.

lines.zh: 我压着呼吸，虽然我没有呼吸。
lines.en: I hold my breath, though I have none to hold.

lines.zh: 月光偏了一寸，我也跟着偏。
lines.en: The moonlight shifts an inch, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我不急，箭在弦上很安稳。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the arrow sits easy on the string.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，破绽最大。
lines.en: When you look up to find me, you are wide open.

lines.zh: 我的准星是环形山磨出来的。
lines.en: My aim was ground sharp by crater dust.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就不必算了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I need no more math.

lines.zh: 我悬在你正上方，风替我算。
lines.en: I hang right above you, and the wind does my math.

lines.zh: 你举手挡月光，正是时候。
lines.en: You raise a hand against the moon. Perfect timing.

lines.zh: 我的箭簇磨自月球石。
lines.en: My arrowheads are ground from moonstone.

lines.zh: 等你跨过那道沟，我就放。
lines.en: Once you cross that trench, I release.

lines.zh: 近身了，我就用弓脊砸下去。
lines.en: At close range I swing the bow's spine down.

lines.zh: 这一箭是贴着你的脸放的。
lines.en: This shot leaves the string right against your face.

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞上你的护甲，声音很脆。
lines.en: My bones strike your armor with a brittle crack.

lines.zh: 你贴太近了，箭来不及飞。
lines.en: You're too close; the arrow has no room to fly.

lines.zh: 我用翼膜抽你的眼睛。
lines.en: I snap my wing membrane across your eyes.

lines.zh: 十四点五的力道，你受得住吗。
lines.en: Can you take fourteen and a half points of it?

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，把你往下拽。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and drag you down.

lines.zh: 月光照在你伤口上，很好看。
lines.en: Moonlight on your wound looks rather fine.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，又补上一下。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, then strike again.

lines.zh: 别以为飞的东西就没有爪子。
lines.en: Don't think a flying thing has no claws.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，下一箭才算。
lines.en: That one was light; the next arrow will not be.

lines.zh: 我的指骨划过你的颈侧。
lines.en: My finger bones rake across the side of your neck.

lines.zh: 你流出的热气，被夜风带走了。
lines.en: The night wind carries off the heat you bleed.

lines.zh: 我落地了，只为打你这一下。
lines.en: I came down to earth just to land this blow.

lines.zh: 我用弓弦勒你的手腕。
lines.en: I cinch the bowstring around your wrist.

lines.zh: 骨指戳进你的肩缝。
lines.en: My bone fingers jab into the seam of your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从月尘里站起来，翼膜先张开。
lines.en: I rise from the moon dust, wing membrane opening first.

lines.zh: 环形山的影子拉长，我就出现了。
lines.en: The crater's shadow lengthens, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我落在这片没有风的地方。
lines.en: I settle into this place where no wind blows.

lines.zh: 幽魂的气息聚成一副骨架。
lines.en: The smell of ghosts gathers into a skeleton.

lines.zh: 月亮转过一个角度，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: The moon turned a degree, and I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我带着弓，从高处开始这一夜。
lines.en: I begin the night from above, bow in hand.

lines.zh: 尘土落定，我的轮廓才清晰。
lines.en: The dust settles and only then am I clear.

lines.zh: 有人在这片月面留下了空位。
lines.en: Someone left an empty place on this moon.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气带着月尘的冷。
lines.en: My first breath carries the chill of moon dust.

lines.zh: 这具身体是新的，弓是旧的。
lines.en: This body is new; the bow is old.

lines.zh: 我数了数星星，然后开始巡行。
lines.en: I count the stars, then begin my patrol.

lines.zh: 月面安静得能听见我自己的骨头。
lines.en: The surface is so quiet I hear my own bones.

lines.zh: 我从陨坑边缘滑下来，落在你附近。
lines.en: I slide down the crater edge and land near you.

lines.zh: 箭囊是满的，夜还很长。
lines.en: The quiver is full, and the night is long.

lines.zh: 火贴上我的翼膜，我立刻往上窜。
lines.en: Fire touches my membrane and I shoot straight up.

lines.zh: 我摔在月尘上，骨头响了一串。
lines.en: I land hard on the dust; my bones rattle in a row.

lines.zh: 水里没有月亮，我不该下来。
lines.en: There is no moon underwater; I should not have come down.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻了，翼膜折成一团。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, my membrane folding shut.

lines.zh: 你也用远程？有意思。
lines.en: You shoot from range too? Now that is interesting.

lines.zh: 这法术烧得比月光烫多了。
lines.en: This spell burns far hotter than moonlight.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西了，饿是幻觉。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago; hunger is a hallucination.

lines.zh: 雷光比我的箭亮，这一下我认输。
lines.en: Lightning outshines my arrow; I yield that round.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有月面，我正往下掉。
lines.en: There is no moon surface in the void; I am falling.
